title: Pro Shop Store Credit: corporate-enrollment suspension surcharge condition
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers a cross-product condition that affects the fee charged when reinstating a suspended Pro Shop Store Credit account, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
Where the member also holds a corporate wellness enrollment, and that enrollment is itself currently suspended for the employer's nonpayment, that corporate wellness program's own late-payment fee becomes a surcharge added onto the reinstatement charge described elsewhere, since a concurrently troubled linked enrollment is itself treated as a fraud-risk signal. Where the member holds no corporate wellness enrollment, or holds one that is not suspended, no such surcharge arises from this condition.
